decisions.reason: Carpet production lies outside the firm's core furniture and material knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate feedback and improve the product.
Hand-knotted carpet craftsmanship is far from the firm's existing capabilities, so it lacks the related knowledge to learn from early results.
This low-pile decorative carpet does not build on the firm's established furniture and material expertise, weakening its absorptive capacity to refine the offering.
As seating furniture, the corner bench draws directly on the firm's existing design and manufacturing knowledge, enabling it to interpret results and improve.
Low-pile carpet production is distant from the firm's core competencies, making it difficult to assimilate market feedback and develop the product further.
The swivel shell chair leverages the firm's core seating and design expertise, allowing it to readily absorb and act on market information.
